title: 秋華賞の後に・流石で、当然！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet wins against Vodka in the Shuka Sho, but she still isn't satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka challenges her to a rematch at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She accepts and watches Vodka leave, vowing to beat her rival once again.
